mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM admin_attachment_main m LEFT JOIN admin_attachment_file f ON m.field_file_id = f.field_id WHERE ${whereSql}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_attachment_main (field_id, field_file_id, field_name, field_create_time, field_uploader_id, field_delete_flag, field_order, field_model_name, field_model_id, field_key) VALUES (#{fieldId}, #{fieldFileId}, #{fieldName}, #{fieldCreateTime}, #{fieldUploaderId}, #{fieldDeleteFlag}, #{fieldOrder}, #{fieldModelName}, #{fieldModelId}, #{fieldKey})
